title: Fiche
description: Per-source analysis persisted to Firestore `fiches/{slug}` (the document key is `slug`, derived from the source title). Written server-side by the Minion `fiches` step, one per source cited in a published article's `## Sources` section. Read by the PWA fiches surface (behind the article's "Consulter toutes les analyses de cet article" CTA). Field names are snake_case to match the persisted document.

slug.description: URL slug derived from the source title. Firestore document key.

theme.description: The fiche's tech-watch theme; rendered as a TagPill in the PWA.

tone.description: The source's tone (e.g. opinion, tutorial, research, news), if identifiable.

used_in.description: Publication dates (YYYY-MM-DD) of every article that cited this source. Grows via array-union on re-citation: a source analyzed once keeps its most recent analysis but accumulates every date it was cited on.

body.description: Fiche body (Markdown): `## Résumé`, `## Points clés`, `## Analyse approfondie`, `## Pourquoi ça compte` sections, in that order.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent (re)generation of this fiche.
